rationale.overall: B better matches the REFERENCE’s overall physical read: a matte-leaning dark slab, a thin grainy curl, a textured-versus-smooth ground split, and a soft contact-lit orange rim without A’s glossier, flatter hardware look.
rationale.material: B’s smoky slab with visible internal depth, semi-matte top-face falloff, thin vertically grained curl, and clear textured/smooth ground polarity sit closer to the REFERENCE’s volumetric shading and translucency than A’s glossier panel and more opaque beige tab.
rationale.silhouette: Both keep the same diagonal rounded block, upper-left curl, and squircle boundary, so the figure read against the split ground is effectively the same.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16 both reduce to the same dark diagonal mass, surviving orange rim pixels, and a near-lost curl smudge, with no clear legibility edge.
